thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: gateway-proxy | P1 detected — elevated 5xx + timeouts across /v1/complete and /v1/chat. First spike at 14:17 UTC. Estimated 12% error rate, customer-impacting. Paging oncall @maria (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-timeouts

maria (oncall): on it. joining call. can someone paste the top correlated error ids?

incident-bot: runbook snippets: mitigation steps 1) check upstream retries 2) gather correlation ids 3) enable fallback route 4) scale gateway pool. Automations: `ops-bot autoscale --service gateway-proxy --count +2`

sam (prod-eng): grabbing logs. initial grep shows repeated `upstream timeout` + `502` with identical correlation-id prefix `corr_3a9f` across many requests. i'll paste a sample.

lee (runtime): dropping a compact log chunk:```
2026-03-15T14:17:05Z gateway-proxy req=corr_3a9f3b user=acct-752 path=/v1/complete status=502 upstream=sched-runner-12 latency=1.2s msg="upstream timeout"
2026-03-15T14:17:05Z gateway-proxy req=corr_3a9f4d user=acct-121 path=/v1/chat status=504 upstream=model-runtime-7 latency=3.4s msg="read deadline exceeded"
2026-03-15T14:17:06Z gateway-proxy req=corr_3a9f85 user=acct-890 path=/v1/complete status=502 upstream=s3-egress-9 latency=0.9s msg="connection reset by peer"
```

irina (sre): pattern looks like burst of upstream retries + some s3 egress resets. can we confirm if retries are amplifying? jon, can you run the retries aggregation query?

jon (observability): running query now: `sum by (upstream) (increase(upstream_retries_total[5m]))` — early result: `sched-runner: +120, model-runtime: +98, s3-egress: +60` — retries correlate with the 14:16-14:19 window.

maria (oncall): customer impact check: which customers impacted? priority accounts?

sam (prod-eng): quick map says spike hits small requests fanout — mostly orgs with heavy parallel calls (acct-752, acct-890). notified AE for acct-752.

lee (runtime): hypothesis 1: model-runtime threadpool underprovisioned -> downstream timeouts -> gateway retries -> retry amplification. hypothesis 2: transient network egress (s3) causing connection resets and partial 502s.

irina (sre): agree. we should: 1) throttle retries at gateway (short-term) 2) add fallback route to smaller model variant 3) scale model-runtime and gateway pool.

maria (oncall): action plan: sam + lee do quick scale, jon throttle retry policy, ops-bot run autoscale. i'll coordinate customer comms.

ops-bot: executed: `autoscale --service model-runtime --delta +3` -> success. `autoscale --service gateway-proxy --delta +2` -> success.

sam (prod-eng): pushed temporary retry-policy change: `gateway.retries.max_attempts=1` and `gateway.retries.backoff_ms=50` (applied to canary routes). monitoring now.

jon (observability): added a dashboard panel to show request volume/5xx/retries per upstream. early signal: error rate dropping from 12% -> 6% within 90s of changes.

lee (runtime): also applied fallback route: `/v1/complete` -> model-quant-small when latency > 1s. traffic split 90/10 initially.

maria (oncall): good. please continue timeline capture in this thread. we need correlation ids for RCA. sam, can you collect a 10m kvlog bundle for 14:10-14:20? include corr ids starting with `corr_3a9f`

sam (prod-eng): uploading logs to internal S3 share: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2421009876/gateway-bundle.tar.gz (ACL: private). bundle contains request traces, kvlogs, and pprof from model-runtime nodes.

jon (observability): initial timeline draft: 14:16:15 first upstream retry spike; 14:17:00 gateway 5xx spike; 14:17:40 autoscale triggered; 14:18:10 retry throttle applied; 14:19:20 error rate trending down. adding to timeline doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2421009876/timeline

irina (sre): capturing hypotheses in-thread: - H1: model-runtime threadpool insufficient (evidence: high latency, retries) - H2: intermittent s3 egress resets magnifying failures (evidence: connection reset lines) - H3: client fanout pattern + retry policy amplifies (evidence: same corr_ prefix across parallel calls)

maria (oncall): marking H1 as highest-priority for immediate RCA. assign to sam + lee to deep dive after stabilization.

sam (prod-eng): ack. i'll start by grep across pprof and heap + check process queues. pulling logs now.

lee (runtime): adding note: node model-runtime-7 reported `ephemeral fd exhaustion` around 14:16 in kernel logs — dumping that into the bundle.

incident-bot: NOTE: customer-impact update: degraded for multiple customers; visible in metrics. postmortem required. page retained.

maria (oncall): we're in mitigation. monitoring for 10m, if stable we'll put a bridge and start RCA. any outstanding ask?

jon (observability): can we tag all traces with the corr_3a9f prefix in the timeline doc and attach sample traces? adding links now.

sam (prod-eng): sample trace: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/corr_3a9f3b -> shows repeated 3xx-ms retried calls to sched-runner then timeout.

irina (sre): next steps: 1) collect kernel logs & ulimit checks on model nodes 2) review retry policy codepath to prevent immediate fanout 3) run incident RCA template once logs are consolidated.

maria (oncall): thanks all. i'll keep this thread as the canonical timeline + hypothesis tracker. if anything new appears, post here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate now at 2.8% (5m rolling). autoscale stabilized.

maria (oncall): closing active pager in 18m if stable, moving to retrospective bridge at 15:00 UTC for RCA kickoff.

sam (prod-eng): collecting A/V evidence and will ping when bundle is ready for sharing with postmortem group.

lee (runtime): one last note: corr_3a9f series looks important — keep those for trace correlation in the RCA.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged closed -> mitigation phase. Postmortem required.
